body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage. One adjacent willing ally may move 1 unit toward the target after the attack.

surges.html: The ally may move 2 units instead.
On a hit, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Combo - Opener
rider.html: After a hit, enter Dawn Stance: the first time each round you protect an adjacent ally with a Prowess Reaction, gain 1 Combo.
